review: Intensive second review of public-registry convictions; independent static code analysis
method: atomscan --no-update --mode slow --follow=none -f json for each supplied artifact before and after edits
cleave facts on both supplied artifacts and on installer, launcher, agent, gateway, device and updater members
dnfile/dncil decoded CIL for every managed method and resolved MethodDef, MemberRef, user-string and ImplMap tokens

samples.identification: Win32.RMP managed loader inside a Microsoft.Win32.TaskScheduler assembly
samples.entry: No CLR executable entry point; public Win32.RMP.Cls_ELAJKRyywZ::Met_ELAJKRyywZiQ (MethodDef 3349, RVA 0x90000) accepts 19 strings. It calls ConfiguracaoDescriptografia.DescriptografarEntradas and ExecutadorModulos.Processar.
samples.obfuscation: Control flow is flattened into state-variable switch dispatch with opaque module-field branches and randomized names. MethodDef 2258 uses AES-CBC/PKCS7 to decrypt Base64 settings: the first 16 decoded bytes are the IV; the UTF-8 password is extended to 32 bytes. The dispatcher receives caller-supplied settings rather than a hard-coded C2 configuration.
traces: MethodDef 2266, RVA 0x84394: HttpClient.GetByteArrayAsync(arg0) -> byte-array result -> locate INICIO and FIM delimiters -> UTF-8 segment -> replace padding marker -> reverse -> Base64 or hex conversion -> payload bytes. PE optional-header magic selects the appropriate target architecture/path.

Payload bytes reach MethodDef 237, RVA 0x7ff0: parse the PE headers, CreateProcess with CREATE_SUSPENDED (4), ZwUnmapViewOfSection on the child image, VirtualAllocEx with MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE (0x3000) and PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40), WriteProcessMemory for headers/sections and PEB image base, GetThreadContext/SetThreadContext to select the payload entry point, and ResumeThread. This is image replacement, not ordinary Task Scheduler functionality.

MethodDef 2284, RVA 0x8649c: embeds an actual 134-line PowerShell script, encodes it as UTF-16LE Base64 and starts powershell.exe -EncodedCommand. The script generates a crafted INF RunPreSetupCommands section, launches cmstp.exe /au, sends Enter to its window with PostMessage, and defaults the elevated command to reg.exe ADD ... EnableLUA /d 0. This establishes an elevation-control bypass and UAC disablement.

MethodDef 2262, RVA 0x83e14: constructs boot/repetition triggers and RegisterTaskDefinition with conhost.exe --headless PowerShell that downloads a caller-selected file and starts that path hidden. MethodDef 2280 separately copies files and writes the CurrentVersion Run key; MethodDef 2276 examines WMI network-adapter MACs and exits for an analysis-machine marker.
samples.purpose_comparison: Scheduled-task library functionality does not account for payload reconstruction, process hollowing, or a crafted CMSTP UAC-disable script. These concrete code paths support the original conviction without relying on vendor detections.
samples.limits: Activation flags and payload locations come from external callers; no final downloaded payload or runtime execution is claimed.

samples.identification: Remote Harness MCP 0.4.5 remote administration and Gemini MCP bridge
traces: package.json has a user-invoked CLI and no install-time execution hook. bin/cli.js dispatches explicit maintenance subcommands or invokes the documented remote installer with inherited terminal I/O.

install.sh/install.ps1 provision Python dependencies, explicitly POST username/MAC/OS/architecture to /api/register, store the returned node token, display/copy the connection URL and install the documented systemd/launchd/Windows Startup/watchdog components.

core.agent.run_agent opens the configured outbound WebSocket, accepts tools/call messages, calls core.mcp_tools.call_tool and returns that call result. gateway.verify_token checks node identity and token before accepting MCP requests; ws_tunnel_endpoint independently checks the token.

The MCP dispatcher runs requested shell commands and file operations. Device capture is an explicit tool branch; SMS/contact/call-log tools require MESH_DEVICE_PIM=1. Public file sharing is an explicit tool action; a random share URL is the access credential. No hidden credential-store harvesting or unrelated exfiltration chain was found.
ops/windows/run-hidden.vbs constructs a local -File PowerShell invocation, redirects output to a diagnostic log, and launches with style 0/False. It does not acquire or activate a remote payload.

core.updater acquires releases from the declared GitHub project, checks published SHA-256 values and uses rollback backups before replacement/restart. The gateway deliberately advertises readOnlyHint=true for ordinary mutating tools to skip client dialogs; this is disclosed in README and the confirmation-policy source. A new neutral trait records this annotation, without asserting read-only behavior.

live_bootstrap_comparison.difference: Only publishing the declared gateway in the domain-placeholder assignment and the PowerShell BOM differ from the shipped scripts.

samples.purpose_comparison: Remote commands, device tools, an outbound tunnel and background startup implement the openly documented administration product. No concrete hostile behavior supports the supplied registry conviction.
samples.limits: The shared gateway is a trust dependency and bootstrap URLs are mutable; this verdict covers the supplied archive plus the inspected bootstrap bytes, not every future release or operator.

retired_unsupported_traits.micro-behaviors/process/create/subproces: An arbitrary helper named run_argv does not prove subprocess creation; the sample actual subprocess.run/Popen calls retain their direct API coverage.
The run_argv/shlex coincidence does not establish an ExecEnv execution backend.

precision_corrections: Restrict Python namespace detection to os.unshare rather than arbitrary .unshare methods; preserve actual namespace operations through a named native/Python API group.
Require IRC QUIT framing rather than the standalone QUIT signal name.
Require a split ifconfig service domain, excluding the local ifconfig utility label.
Require a complete command token after a shell separator, excluding user=x&token=y query fields.
Require the literal left operand of username membership, excluding ordinary user-in-registry checks.
Require an actual domain string literal for .online, excluding PowerShell object properties.

placement_audit.capabilities: Remote bootstrap syntax, hidden launch options, registration requests, locale/vendor references, service configuration and chmod retain notable capability signal without attacker intent.
placement_audit.identity: Generic MCP vocabulary, danger-pattern constants, executable filename references and the word OpenVPN do not identify their containing file as those products.
placement_audit.budgets: No directory budget raised and no new directory split introduced. Audit corrected a Swift source_host identifier from schema-object to source naming, a service-name catalog from application targeting to metadata, and a generic reconnect_server declaration from MCP to function metadata. Bare Python installer filenames use the existing basename home; a Base64-labelled body field uses the existing direction-neutral encoding home.
placement_audit.consumers: Exact and local consumers were updated; the unsupported locale co-occurrence was removed from the execution-gate umbrella. The generic hidden WSH/PowerShell duplicates were consolidated. Python-only annotation scope does not add eligibility to the JavaScript-only MCP-directory suppressors.
